Web testing with the **Browser library** rests on three layers:

- **Browser** — the engine process (Chromium here). `New Browser`.
- **Context** — an isolated session: its own cookies and storage. `New Context`.
- **Page** — a tab inside a context. `New Page`.

Two contexts are two independent customers — separate logins, separate carts.
This lesson proves that isolation against the bundled **RF Demo Shop**.

> **Note:** The Browser library needs its engine once. If a run complains the
> browser isn't installed, run `uv run rfbrowser init chromium` (a large,
> one-time download).

```diagram
tree "Engine, context, page"
Browser #gear -- New Browser (the engine) {
  BrowserContext -- New Context (own cookies) {
    Page #file -- New Page (a tab)
  }
}
note "Two contexts are two isolated customers"
```

## Task 1 — Start the RF Demo Shop and keep it running

The shop is a small local app. Start it in a terminal and leave it running:

```bash
uv run python demo_app/serve.py
```

It serves the web shop on `http://localhost:7272`.

**Check:** the shop answers on its port.

## Task 2 — Prove two contexts are two isolated customers

**Goal:** create `checks/browser_model.robot` where one context signs in and sees
the catalog, then a second, fresh context visits the catalog and is bounced to
the login page — proving the sessions are isolated.

Here is the same isolation proof signed in as a different user. Adapt it.
(`../resources/shop.resource` gives you `${BASE_URL}`.)

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Two Sessions Stay Separate
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    reviewer_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/catalog
    Get Url    contains    /login
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** the isolation test passes with two contexts.

<!-- hint -->
Sign the first context in as `primary_user`, then confirm the catalog with
`Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Open a second `New Context` and `New Page    ${BASE_URL}/catalog` without signing
in — a fresh session is bounced, so `Get Url    contains    /login`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Two Customers Have Isolated Sessions
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/catalog
    Get Url    contains    /login
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /solution -->

**Check:** the isolation test passes with two contexts.
